audit.summary: Archived assessment: Major. The NS5 Cartesian square contains additional points; Printed D5 table fails moment compatibility; Co-separated one-term fusion coefficient has the wrong range
limitations: M25-0182-P01 — The NS5 Cartesian square contains additional points — Counterevidence: j remains closed and p proper in the example; all A-fixed points are in L; no counterexample to the conclusion of Lemma7.7, Theorem7.9 or normalized mirror duality.

M25-0182-P02 — Printed D5 table fails moment compatibility — Counterevidence: The coherent negative signs in Example6.1 repair the elementary separated moment equations; existence of the intended geometric embedding is not disproved.

M25-0182-P03 — Co-separated one-term fusion coefficient has the wrong range — Counterevidence: General Theorem6.13 diagonal-factor form is not refuted. Common scalar cancellation can preserve normalized ratios and mirror duality.

M25-0182-P04 — Normalization needs the attracting graph — Counterevidence: The correct diagonal factor already appears in Remark5.5 and the inspected core proof calculations; this is the basis for Minor, not merely ease of repair.

M25-0182-P05 — Full coefficient-field restriction is undefined — Counterevidence: Unlocalized restriction and compatible multiplicative systems exist; intended regular stable classes may be in this domain. No counterexample to the image conclusion or mirror theorem established.
